notes.title: Patch notes!
notes.content:
The bugs identified by Euphoniac were taken care of (thanks again for the thorough look).  

Also - I removed level-scaling from common enemies (Boss level were always hard-coded).  There is still a level range for each area, but you will cap out much quicker than before.  It will make gaining levels much more rewarding for you!

I know that sometimes updates mess with your save files.  I'll try to keep the updates meaningful and at a non-invasive rate as to reduce this undesired effect.

Thanks!
